description: Subdomain names found in public Certificate Transparency logs for a domain (via CertSpotter): unique host names and wildcard names, issuers, latest issue date and how many listed certificates are still valid. Returns the first page only (up to 100 certificates) and lists at most 100 names; wildcard names are shown as *.domain. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_crtsh_transparency
